ModMetaData.name: Bred in Captivity
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: Animals born to two colony-tamed parents of the same species are slightly less wild than the more domesticated parent, building up generation by generation until Wildness reaches 0%. Once an animal is domesticated enough (about 10% Wildness or less, so always at 0%), its tameness no longer decays and it never needs tameness re-training. The reduction per generation (default 8 percentage points) is configurable in the mod settings.
